automation.description: Signs in as admin in PrimeFaces (tablet UX/UI) and runs the actions that change the whole server, using safe values, after every other member has finished and before the restore puts the data back.

interaction.name: Clear the completed jobs list
interaction.description: Clears the completed jobs list so that this script's job rows can be told apart.

method.comment: This member waits for its jobs by their rows in the completed jobs list: clear it first, so that a row left by another member (the other renderer's 98-destructive.xml, if it stopped early) cannot be taken for this member's. The admin suite runs both 05-reports-misc.xml members, which check the backup's row, before either 98-destructive.xml.

interaction.name: Configuration: save safe values (mail is only logged)
interaction.description: Saves Configuration with explicit safe values and test mail turned on, and checks they are kept after reopening.

interaction.name: Mail: a test email, and sends that refuse without recipients
interaction.description: Checks the test email form is hidden because mail is not configured, and that sending a communication with nothing tagged is refused.

method.comment: The test email form shows only when email is configured, which the test server's localhost SMTP is not

interaction.name: Test data: generate tagged data, check it cannot be rerun, then delete the tagged data
interaction.description: Generates three tagged Contact records from the Control Panel as a job, checks the job completes and cannot be rerun, then deletes the tagged data with a second job.

method.comment: Test data is generated by a job: wait for its row in the completed jobs list (the first interaction cleared the list)
Runtime issue P6: the job was started with the Control Panel, which the job record does not keep, so it cannot be rerun (the rerun failed)

testMessage.contains: Delete All Tagged Data For Tag Job has been started

method.comment: The delete is a job: wait for its row in the completed jobs list

interaction.name: Jobs: delete the completed jobs
interaction.description: Deletes the completed jobs, declining once and then confirming, and checks the list is empty.
